0022600126.text: The Utah Jazz (1-2, fifth in the Northwest and 11th in the West, on a one-game losing streak) host the Memphis Grizzlies (3-0, second in the Southwest and fifth in the West, on a three-game winning streak) in the Jazz's fourth game of the season. Utah is 1-1 at home, while Memphis is 2-0 on the road, and the Grizzlies won the only 2026-27 meeting 123-103 in Memphis on October 21, leaving the Jazz trailing 0-1 in that season series, though the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2. Utah is missing Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), all listed as out, while Memphis's Karim Lopez is day-to-day with a knee bruise and is a game-time decision.
